Promoted

Opting in for a promoted event will make it visible on VRC.TL to all visitors. This requires your event to fully match the description and requirements of the chosen category. In general, promoted events are expected to be well-planned, with the event description clearly outlining what attendees can expect throughout the entire duration by including a timetable of performers and describing the activities or performances.

Not promoted

Not promoted event will be visible on VRC.TL only to users following your club. In exchange, rules and requirements for posting events are much more relaxed.

Theatre & Art

Events with live stage performances including dancing, acting, singing, or stand up comedy qualify for this category. This category is NOT for any type of movie watching.

This is pretty wide category so please always write what is event about in to event description.
